title: viola tenuicornis subsp. ircutiana
intro: Viola tenuicornis subsp. ircutiana, commonly known as  the ircut viola, is a plant species that belongs to the Violaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the management of various health conditions such as pain, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of ircut viola are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of ircut viola and to confirm its efficacy in various health conditions.
